curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with driving as a privilege rather than a right, then the grounds for losing it, suspensions decided case by case, the re-examination of a problem driver, the habitual offender definition and suspension for unpaid child support.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for mandatory versus case-by-case suspensions and for the habitual offender count.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the grounds for suspension, who decides and the habitual offender rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the age of twenty-one for alcohol, the penalty for underage buying or drinking where alcohol is sold, when a suspension starts for someone with no license, then the underage first-offense BAC range, suspension and community service.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the underage BAC range versus the adult limit and for the two underage penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the underage fine, suspension range, start date and community service.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare the two first-DUI fine tiers, add the annual surcharge, then cover IDRC detention, its charges, county versus regional centers and treatment referral as a condition of relicensing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the lower versus higher BAC tier and county versus regional IDRCs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on first-DUI fines, the surcharge, IDRC charges and which center an offender attends.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the implied consent law, what happens to a driver who refuses the breath test, the refusal surcharge and loss of privileges until an interlock is installed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the refusal surcharge versus the first-DUI surcharge.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on implied consent, the hospital blood draw and refusal penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show how an interlock works and its threshold against the adult limit, then the interlock terms for each first-DUI tier, a refusal and a repeat offense, voluntary early installation and the penalty for skipping a court-ordered interlock.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the legal limit versus the interlock threshold and for each interlock term.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps interlock terms across BAC tiers, refusals and repeat offenses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through first, second and third driving-while-suspended penalties, the tougher penalty when the suspension was for DUI, refusal or habitual offending, the school-zone penalty, the fourth-degree crime and the owner who lends the car.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the three offense levels and for ordinary versus DUI-related suspensions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on fines, jail terms and added suspension for driving while suspended.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover unsafe driving fines and points, a first reckless driving offense, doubled fines in sixty-five zones and work zones, passing a vulnerable road user, lighting the compartment at a stop and open containers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for work zones versus sixty-five zones and injury versus no injury.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on moving violation fines, points and doubled-fine zones.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish with snow and flying ice fines, abandoning a vehicle on a highway, hit-and-run, insurance fraud, lying on an application, taking a test for someone else and boating while intoxicated.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for first versus repeat abandonment and the two fraud-style offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the fines, jail terms and license losses for these offenses.
